name: Burton Farmers and Artisans Market
tagline: Deeply Rooted Ranch — Artisan bread in Burton, TX
description: Burton Farmers and Artisans Market gathers local farms and food producers in 307 North Main St. Burton, TX. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
